data.value: iCurePet is designed to make managing of veterinary clini more easy and efficient, enabling veterinarians and staff keep track of pet records, appointments, medical history, and generate reports quickly. This system help save time on paperwork so veterinarians and staff can focus more on taking care of the animals.

data.name: label9.Text
data.value: iCurePet is designed to simplify veterinary clinic management by organizing records, appointments, and medical history into one efficient system. It helps clinics operate more smoothly and reduce time spent on manual tasks.
